about: The Haftarah from the Prophets remembers how Jacob ran away and worked hard for his wife. It ends with God calling Israel to come back home to him. The reading from the Apostles reminds us of Jacob’s dream of a ladder. Yeshua tells Nathanael that he will see angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
